newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tanker off Japan stops leaking gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Tanker off Japan stops leaking gasoline.

text.p: A gasoline leak from a coastal tanker that collided with a liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) ship on Wednesday morning off southern Japan stopped after 50 kilolitres (kl) had been spilt, maritime authorities said.

The 199 gross-registered-tonne tanker was carrying 630 kl of gasoline when it collided with the empty LPG vessel four km off Kunisaki Peninsula on Kyushu at 11.10 a.m. (0210 GMT), a spokesman for the regional headquarters of the Maritime Safety Agency said.
Clean-up operations are likely to be unnecessary as most of the spilt gasoline has evaporated, he said.
No one was injured in the accident and the cause of the collision is under investigation, he added.
